runtime_context: A completed ball record rec. All stats used here are captured in rec, not read back from a mutated innings.

paths.rec.shot: Attempted input family: drive, cutpull, loft, defend, leave, ramp, sweep or reverseSweep.
paths.rec.shotName: Realised shot label from batting.js; commonly empty on a miss. Not a separate input choice.
paths.rec.contact: middle, thinEdge, thickEdge, insideEdge, topEdge, bottomEdge, gloved, padPop or none.
paths.rec.runsBat: Runs credited to the batter on this ball.
paths.rec.total: All runs on this ball, including extras. {r} refers to this value.
paths.rec.boundary: Boundary award: 0, 4 or 6. Do not infer this from total alone.
paths.rec.extra.type: Explicit null for no extras, or wd, nb, b, lb. Missing is not null.
paths.rec.dropped: Explicit null, or the position/role label of a fielder who dropped a catch.
paths.rec.wicket: Explicit null, or the dismissal object.
paths.rec.wicket.how: bowled, caught, lbw, stumped or runout.
paths.rec.wicket.caughtBehind: Boolean for catches; may be absent on other dismissals.
paths.rec.padVerdict: Empty string if no pad contact. A nonempty tracking reason when hit on pad; not proof an appeal happened.
paths.rec.quality: Contact quality; this pack uses 0.55 as an editorial boundary for timing language, not a gameplay change.
paths.rec.bounceNote: low or high for unusual bounce; another value or missing means no low/high template.
paths.rec.beatBat: A played-and-missed event in the current model. It does not identify which side of the bat was beaten.
paths.rec.missReason: early, late, beaten, or another source reason. Timing-specific templates require early/late explicitly.
paths.rec.seenBall.line: Existing describeBall classification: stumps, off, wide or leg. wide here is a line, not an umpire wide call.
paths.rec.movement.spin: Boolean from movementOf: whether the delivery was bowled by a spinner.
paths.rec.movement.swing: Signed actual lateral air movement in metres, used only to derive an absolute value.
paths.rec.freeHit: Boolean before the ball. Dropped-chance templates require false, so they do not imply a catch dismissal on a free hit.
paths.rec.moment.kind: Existing MomentTracker classification; compute once per ball, not again during rendering.
paths.facts.swing_abs_m: Pure adapter value: Math.abs(rec.movement.swing), only when the source number is finite. Not a new simulation feature.

placeholders.b: Existing short name of the dismissed batter if rec.wicket is present, otherwise rec.striker. Snapshot before switching scenes or innings.
placeholders.f: rec.dropped or rec.wicket.fielder. These are usually position/role labels, not a player name. Do not invent a specific fielder.
placeholders.r: rec.total, including extras; fixed run phrases additionally guard runsBat, total and boundary.
placeholders.s: rec.shotName, only used by templates that explicitly require supported nonempty shot names.
placeholders.n: rec.moment.n with event-specific meaning; retain zero. Never assume it always means runs.
placeholders.k: rec.moment.k, mapped to a number word for collapse counts; retain zero and do not treat a missing value as zero.

moment_n_meaning.offTheMark: Balls faced including this ball in the current detector. Pack lines do not quote this number.
moment_n_meaning.droughtEnds: Prior consecutive scoreless balls faced by this batter.
moment_n_meaning.dotsBuilding: Current consecutive scoreless balls for the team.
moment_n_meaning.maiden: Unused in this pack. Byes/leg byes may coexist with a bowler maiden.
moment_n_meaning.standBroken: Partnership total at the wicket, as supplied by MomentTracker.
moment_n_meaning.fifty: Balls faced in the current detector; the pack says fifty, not {n} runs.
moment_n_meaning.hundred: Balls faced in the current detector; the pack says a hundred, not {n} runs.
moment_n_meaning.collapse: Runs in the detector's recent wicket cluster; k is the wicket count.
moment_n_meaning.winningRuns: Unused; moment kind itself identifies the successful chase.
moment_n_meaning.droppedOn: Batter score when the catch was dropped, before this ball's scoring is applied.

excluded_inferences: No named second slip, gully or other precise passing point without a recorded trajectory and actual field placement.
No ball falling short of a catch merely because an edge produced zero runs.
No diving, one-handed, overhead or boundary-saving catch without a matching fielding event.
No direct-hit, mix-up, overstep, shot direction, easy run, keeper error, weather or crowd action inferred from a generic result.
No claim that a single changes who faces the next ball: the over may have ended.
No six dot balls inferred from a maiden, because byes and leg byes are not charged to the bowler.
